summary: Re-review of the remediation commits 9f223935 (Red r5) and 61ab994e/edeb8529 (Green r3) since my r1 at 3c87971a. The 4 new tests mean what they claim: the r5 capture shows 4 failed | 37 passed before Green (only the new cases fail), and the r3 mutant gate proves each new rule, when removed, fails its named test.
